channel.title: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Maine — Opinions (govinfo)
channel.description: Official GPO govinfo USCOURTS feed of new/updated Bankr. D. Maine opinions with authenticated GPO PDFs. Feed URL taken from GPO's own published feed directory (github.com/usgpo/rss). Complements fed-meb-opinions (court's own PDF listing) and fed-meb-opinions-cl (CourtListener); overlap between the three is expected.
